recipeInstructions.name: Mix poolish
recipeInstructions.text: On the first night, mix the poolish flour, water, sourdough starter, and honey. Leave overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: Add remaining ingredients
recipeInstructions.text: The next morning, add the remaining flour, water, and salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Stretch and fold
recipeInstructions.text: Stretch and fold every 30 minutes over 2 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Bulk ferment
recipeInstructions.text: Bulk ferment until the night of day 2.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide
recipeInstructions.text: Divide into three 320 g dough balls.
